title_en: Apartment for Sale, 21 December – Ex-Patent Area
description_en: Apartment 2+1 | 76 m² | New Construction | Totally Renovated In one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana, we present this modern apartment for sale with an area of ​​76 m², located in a new and well-managed building.
